label: A2B_cI36_229_h_d-001
title: Hypothetical SiO$_{2}$-like WN$_{2}$ structure
comments:
This structure was studied by (Mehl, 2015) as part of an effort to understand vacancy formation in the N$_{1-x}$W$_{x}$ system.  It was produced by removing 4 nitrogen and 10 tungsten atoms from a 64-atom supercell of the \href{current_web_home_dir/AB_cF8_225_a_b-001}{rock salt ($B1$) structure}. The resulting structure leaves four nitrogen atoms forming a tetrahedron around each tungsten atom, with the perfect regular tetrahedron occuring when y$_{2}$ = 1/$\sqrt{8}$ with an N-W-N bond angle of 109.47$^\circ$.  It is similar to the \href{current_web_home_dir/A2B_cF24_227_c_a-001}{idealized $\beta$-cristobalite SiO$_{2}$ structure}, although the current structure has never been reported for any compound. 
 The y$_{2}$-value for this structure reported in (Mehl, 2015) Table VI should be replaced by 1/2 - y$_{2}$, as we do here.
